description: This file defines a custom view component called SlidingTabLayout, which integrates with a ViewPager to display customizable tab indicators for paging through content. It includes interface definitions for color customization, methods for setting up the view, and internal classes for handling tab interaction and page change events.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that displays tabs synchronized with a ViewPager, allowing for customized tab views and colorizations.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface to control the indicator and divider colors of tabs individually.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with the tab layout and populates tabs based on its adapter.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView styled as a tab in absence of a custom layout.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Creates and adds tab views to the layout based on the ViewPager's adapter.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the layout to make the selected tab visible, optionally with an offset.
